title: Message on WhatsApp
desc: Tell me briefly what you're looking for: a second opinion, checkup, or specific treatment. You don't need to write much.

title: I reply with available times
desc: I share my availability and we schedule the appointment. I usually have openings within the week.

title: First evaluation visit
desc: The first visit is for assessment, explanation, and planning. Not for acting before you know what's going to happen.
